field_rules: Drivetrain must identify the selected exact custom listing option; a menu of available builds does not resolve the retained card.
Complete-bike weight must map to the exact complete build and state size/configuration or preserve missing protocol details; do not add frame and fork weights.
Maximum tire clearance must be a stated model/frame maximum; fitted tire size is insufficient.
Frame stiffness requires an exact-model numeric result or sufficiently specific independent assessment; identify build-specific evidence and protocol limitations.
excluded: No agent edits; no XHS/Weibo, personal browser, login/CAPTCHA, seller outreach, external messages, quote submission, cart, checkout, or purchase.
No prices or images. Only frozen fields and directly supporting source/attempt records, coverage baseline if required, attempt-count expectation if stale, and dated batch documentation may change.
No commit, push, PR, merge, publish, or production change.
